title: Student Dropout Prediction in Ghanaian Basic Schools Using Machine Learning
summary: A machine learning pipeline for early prediction of student dropout in Ghanaian basic schools, comparing baseline classifiers with SHAP explainability and class-imbalance handling via SMOTE and CTGAN. The project's Class Imbalance and Data Augmentation notebooks run CTGAN (with sdv also pinned as a dependency) to generate synthetic minority-class records for comparison against SMOTE.
